deals.note: Linden Capital paid 15x to 16x EBITDA for pharma marketing business Relevate Health from Mountaingate Capital , per Axios Pro .
R&B Wholesale Distributors , a portfolio company of Platinum Equity , acquired Grand Appliance , a Sturtevant, Wis.-based appliances and electronics distributor.
Vetspire , an SF-based veterinary software company, received a growth investment from Battery Ventures .

Wolf-Gordon , a Charger Investment Partners portco making interior surface finishes, acquired Andor Willow , a wood wall panel and room divider maker, and Look Walls & Interiors , a custom wallcovering maker.
Airtel Africa , a telecom operator planning to list its mobile payments arm in London, is considering having the shares trade in U.S. dollars to match its reporting currency, per Bloomberg.
Quest Global Services , a Singaporean engineering services firm backed by Carlyle , hired banks for a Mumbai IPO that could raise as much as $1b, per Bloomberg.

deals.company: Robinhood Ventures Fund II began trading on the New York Stock Exchange yesterday. The fund
deals.note: Robinhood Ventures Fund II began trading on the New York Stock Exchange yesterday. The fund raised roughly $200m in its IPO at $25 per share.
Svatantra Microfin , an Indian non-banking lender backed by Advent , filed for an IPO worth $314.33m.
ACCO Brands , a Lake Zurich, Ill.-based branded consumer products company, is buying Trust , a Netherlands-based consumer electronics company backed by Egeria .

Core Scientific (Nasdaq: CORZ), an Austin, Texas-based blockchain infrastructure and software company, completed its previously announced $444m acquisition of cryptocurrency mining company Polaris DS from Altair Capital .

deals.company: Diversified Energy is in early talks to buy Birch Resources
deals.note: Diversified Energy is in early talks to buy Birch Resources , which is backed by Elliott Investment Management and operates in the Permian Basin.
Goldman Sachs Asset Management is looking to sell clinical trial software company 4G Clinical, per Axios Pro .

deals.company: Renovus Capital Partners is exiting Thought Logic Consulting through Braemont Capital's recapitalization of the Atlanta-based enterprise consultancy.
deals.note: Renovus Capital Partners is exiting Thought Logic Consulting through Braemont Capital's recapitalization of the Atlanta-based enterprise consultancy.
ZPG , backed by Silver Lake , will sell Hometrack , which provides residential property valuation and risk data & analytics in the U.K. and Netherlands, to Providence Equity Partners .
C&S Wholesale Grocers agreed to buy a majority stake in Winn-Dixie , a Jacksonville, Fla.-based privately held grocery and liquor store chain.

deals.company: Activist investor Engine Capital told H.B
deals.note: Activist investor Engine Capital told H.B. Fuller (NYSE: FUL) that it should run a market check for its building adhesive solutions business and engage with Ancora's more than $1b offer for it.
Ensign Energy Services , a Canadian oilfield services company, closed its acquisition of Citadel Drilling for $65m.
Frasers bought Harvey Nichols , the British luxury department store chain founded in 1831, out of administration.

deals.company: Mobix Labs is buying Special Project Delivery
deals.note: Mobix Labs is buying Special Project Delivery , a Newport Beach, Calif.-based infrastructure developer focused on national security, critical resources and public-infrastructure finance. mobixlabs.com
Nasdaq is buying Level Markets , an off-exchange equity execution venue.
Semtech , a Camarillo, Calif.-based semiconductor provider, is selling its cellular module business to Compal Electronics for $62m in cash.

deals.company: Volkswagen is preparing to reduce its roughly €16.6b majority stake in truckmaker Traton
deals.note: Volkswagen is preparing to reduce its roughly €16.6b majority stake in truckmaker Traton , as part of its broader cost-cutting effort.
Xylem (NYSE: XYL), a Washington, D.C.-based water technology company, agreed to acquire the Cornell Pump and Roper Pump businesses from Indicor for $1.46b.
1789 Capital has closed a $1.2b real estate development fund.
